functions.name: setPrefs
functions.description: Live-apply a map of about:config preferences. Values may be boolean, string or integer.

functions.name: getPrefs
functions.description: Read the current values of a list of preferences.

functions.name: clearPrefs
functions.description: Clear user values for a list of preferences. A pref with a default falls back to it.

functions.name: getPrefsByPrefix
functions.description: Read every USER-SET preference whose name starts with the given prefix, as [{name, type, value}]. Defaults are not returned; used by the state sync to carry the whole rozelynx.* configuration without a hand-maintained name list.
